excerpt.zh: 在击溃了投机取巧的海盗之后，我们可以自由地索取[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的宝藏了。
excerpt.en: Having routed the opportunistic pirates, we are now free to claim the treasure trove on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName].
